title: Right of self-defense in Maryland
intro: In the state of Maryland, the right of self-defense is mostly governed by case law, but there is also a statute.

title: Rigour
intro: Rigour (British English) or rigor (American English; see spelling differences) describes a condition of stiffness or strictness. These constraints may be environmentally imposed, such as "the rigours of famine"; logically imposed, such as mathematical proofs which must maintain consistent answers; or socially imposed, such as the process of defining ethics and law.

title: Rising sun lemma
intro: In mathematical analysis, the rising sun lemma is a lemma due to Frigyes Riesz, used in the proof of the Hardy–Littlewood maximal theorem.  The lemma was a precursor in one dimension of the Calderón–Zygmund lemma.

title: Robbie McIntosh
categories: Musicians from the London Borough of Sutton
intro: Robbie McIntosh (born 25 October 1957) is an English guitarist. McIntosh is best known as a session guitarist and member of the Pretenders from 1982 until 1987.

title: Robert Spaemann
intro: Robert Spaemann (5 May 1927 – 10 December 2018) was a German Catholic philosopher. He is considered a member of the Ritter School.

title: Robinson's joint consistency theorem
categories: Theorems in the foundations of mathematics
intro: Robinson's joint consistency theorem is an important theorem of mathematical logic. It is related to Craig interpolation and Beth definability.

title: Rokhlin lemma
intro: In mathematics, the Rokhlin lemma, or Kakutani–Rokhlin lemma is an important result in ergodic theory. It states that an aperiodic measure preserving dynamical system can be decomposed to an arbitrary high tower of measurable sets and a remainder of arbitrarily small measure.
